messages.subject: Simulating a capture-recapture-recovery (MRR) database
parts:
Good afternoon,

I am trying to simulate a MRR database in R but I am doing something wrong because the estimated parameters (after running jags model) do not mach with those I am simulating from. Any help would appreciated, I am really desperate...

Here is my code:

n.occasions <- 10
## Annual number of newly marked individuals
n.marked <- c(rep(10,9)) # 90 individuals

# Define a vector with the occasion of marking
mark.occ <- rep(1:length(n.marked), n.marked[1:length(n.marked)])

## States and CH matrix
a <- RR <- CH <- matrix(0,ncol=n.occasions, nrow = sum(n.marked))
z <- matrix(NA,ncol=n.occasions, nrow = sum(n.marked))
r <- rep(0.02,n.occasions)

## We need to include age matrices (survival and recapture age-dependent)
## Age matrices (until 4+)
S <- matrix(NA, ncol = dim(CH)[2], nrow = sum(n.marked))
p <- matrix(NA, ncol = dim(CH)[2], nrow = sum(n.marked))
gamma <- matrix(NA, ncol = dim(CH)[2], nrow = sum(n.marked))

vec.age.S <- c(0.60, 0.85, 0.88, rep(0.91,n.occasions-3))
vec.age.p <- c(1,0.06, 0.27, 0.38, rep(0.37, n.occasions-2))
vec.age.g <- c(0.20, 0.07,rep(0.32, n.occasions-2))
f.inverse <- (dim(CH)[2]+1) - mark.occ

for (i in 1:dim(CH)[1]){
  S[i,mark.occ[i]:dim(S)[2]] <- vec.age.S[1:f.inverse[i]]
  p[i,mark.occ[i]:dim(S)[2]] <- vec.age.p[1:f.inverse[i]]
  gamma[i,mark.occ[i]:dim(S)[2]] <- vec.age.g[1:f.inverse[i]]
}

## Simulation function
simul.MRR <- function(z, a, RR, n.marked, S=S, gamma=gamma, r=r, p=p){
  for (i in 1:sum(n.marked)){
    CH[i,mark.occ[i]] <- 1
    z[i,mark.occ[i]] <- 1
    a[i,mark.occ[i]] <- 1
    RR[i,mark.occ[i]] <- 1
   
    for (t in (mark.occ[i]): (n.occasions-1)){
      #alive next period
      z[i,t+1] <- rbinom(1,1,z[i,t]*S[i,t])
      #available for capture
      a[i,t+1] <- rbinom(1,1,z[i,t+1]*a[i,t]*(1-gamma[i,t]))
      #captured
      CH[i,t+1] <- rbinom(1,1,a[i,t+1]*p[i,t+1])
      ## recovered
      RR[i,t+1] <- rbinom(1,1,z[i,t]*(1-z[i,t+1])*r[t])
      if(RR[i,t+1]==1) { CH[i,t+1] <- 2}
    }
      print(t)
      }
  out <- list(z=z,a=a,CH=CH,RR=RR)
}

sim.MRR <- simul.MRR(z, a, RR, n.marked, S=S, gamma=gamma, r=r, p=p)

Thanks in advance,

Blanca
